## I had completed more than ten…
I had completed more than ten transactions on Tori and maintained an excellent user rating of 9.9. On the same day, someone even contacted me in the morning asking about buying my phone. Then, in the afternoon, I suddenly could no longer log into my account.  
  
My account was disabled without any email, warning, or explanation. To this day, I still don't know what I supposedly did wrong.  
  
It's very frustrating to have an account disabled without any transparency or communication. This is a really disappointing platform.
